description:
Hi, I'm Irfan Ullah, a Computer Science student at UET Peshawar. I'm a Full Stack Developer handling the entire web platform, database, and UI for the challenge.

I need a team to help bring the data to life! I'm looking for a Data Scientist to process the radar data, a UI/UX Designer, and someone with Earth Science or AI knowledge to help shape the idea. If you're from UET or just love space tech and want to build a winning project, join my team. Let's get to work!
